relations.description: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST may be affected by Back-off timer value IE presence.
Bearer resource modification procedure starts back-off timer when timer value is provided.
ESM cause #32 establishes use of SM_RetryWaitTime as back-off timer value.
ESM cause #33 establishes use of SM_RetryWaitTime as back-off timer value.
Back-off timer value IE guards the behavior of back-off timer (start, deactivate, or zero value).
Re-attempt indicator IE guards whether back-off timer applies to different modes.
